messages:
rachel: Heads up — deploybot is scheduled to start the v2 rollout for eu-west in ~2h. I pulled staging telemetry and we saw a small 429 spike on streaming endpoints during long-lived connections. Thinking we should delay the push by 2 hours to add a short release-note addendum about SDK reconnect/backoff behavior and run a pin-export for tenants we know have long-polling clients.

deploybot: @channel automated reminder: v2 rollout (eu-west) scheduled at 2026-03-21T16:00Z. Current preflight checks: HEALTH=pass, CANARY=pass, RATE=warn.

sam: Thanks — can you paste the 429 traces? is it client side misbehave or our rate cap?
rachel: quick snippet from staging logs: ``ERROR request_id=abc123 status=429 route=/v2/stream token_id=tenant-42 duration=00:12:03``. It correlates with long-lived streaming sessions hitting our per-tenant concurrent-token cap.

anya: If it's concurrent-cap limit, a release-note addendum plus a temporary increase to burst capacity for dedicated tenants might help. But that needs ops signoff.
mike: Ops will need concrete list of affected tenants. Can we run a pin-export now to build the list?
tariq: I can run the tenant export job. Doing it now — will share CSV in a minute.

ops-bot: @tariq export-job started (job_id=exp-20260321-01). Estimated completion ~45s.

rachel: If export shows >5 tenants with streaming footprint, I'm leaning to delay 2h so docs + hotpatch config for burst caps. Otherwise proceed on schedule but include the note.

deploybot: Update: deploybot healthcheck: all canaries healthy. Suggested action: proceed as scheduled OR delay by up to 3h on operator command.

ops-bot: export-job complete. CSV uploaded to //internal/exports/v2-pin-export-7532109876.csv — found 8 tenants with >10 concurrent streams in staging profile.

sam: 8 is above my personal threshold for not delaying. Recommend delay 2h; also add a client-facing snippet for SDKs showing recommended backoff:
```
// pseudo
onDisconnect -> exponentialBackoff(retries=6, base=250ms)
reconnect -> jittered
```

anya: Agree. I'll draft the addendum and a short SDK code snippet for release notes + the migration FAQ.

mike: Ops, what's the effort to bump per-tenant burst caps temporarily? need a runbook link pls.
tariq: We have a one-off escalation patch that increases the per-tenant concurrent stream cap by +20 for eu-west — low-risk and reversible. Prep ETA 25m.

rachel: OK plan: pause rollout, set new schedule for +2h (2026-03-21T18:00Z), ops to apply temp burst patch before rollout, anya writes addendum and posts to release notes, sam prepares SDK snippet. I'll update releasebot and tenant comms. Anyone object?

mike: no objections. thumbs up. :thumbsup:
tariq: will start patch after I finish a quick test — ping when ready.

deploybot: Action logged: rollout delayed by operator rachel until 2026-03-21T18:00Z. To proceed earlier, respond `proceed` in this thread.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll open a quick follow-up thread with link to the updated release notes and attach the pin CSV for customer success.

anya: I'll aim to have the addendum + FAQ up in 45m and ping here.

sam: I'll also add a short note in the migration checklist about streaming reconnection behavior.

ops-bot: patch applied to eu-west: per-tenant concurrent-stream cap +20 (patch_id=patch-75321-eu). Monitoring for 10m.

mike: seeing no abnormal metrics in the patch window.

rachel: Great — stand by for the release-note post and then we resume at 18:00Z. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
